context.body: Announced destruction is met by intercession grounded in God’s earlier words.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: God tells Moses of Israel’s corruption, announces consuming wrath, and relents after Moses appeals to reputation and promise.
observations.label: God threatens judgment and relents: action

observations.body: Israel makes and worships the calf; Moses intercedes before seeing the camp.
observations.label: God threatens judgment and relents: response

payload.posture: Read Exodus 32:1–14 as name and deliverance evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage says God relents without resolving how that response relates to other texts about divine constancy.
payload.title: God threatens judgment and relents
